name: claude-cognitive-toolkit
description: Guided CBT and DBT practice exercises for AI assistants: thought record, Opposite Action, TIPP, DEAR MAN with roleplay, Wise Mind, Chain Analysis and Behavioral Activation, with configurable pushback levels and optional health context.
author: Gleb Kalinin

techniques.name: Thought Record
techniques.description: 7-step cognitive restructuring: situation, automatic thought, emotion rating, evidence for, evidence against, balanced thought, re-rating. Distortions are classified silently against Burns' taxonomy; an accuracy check exits to problem-solving when the thought is true.

techniques.name: Opposite Action
techniques.description: DBT emotion regulation skill: name the emotion, identify the action urge, check whether it is justified by the facts, and act opposite only if it is not.

techniques.name: TIPP
techniques.description: Distress-tolerance skill for acute arousal: choose one of temperature, intense exercise, paced breathing or paired muscle relaxation, then re-rate. Cold water is offered only after a medical screening question.

techniques.name: DEAR MAN
techniques.description: Interpersonal-effectiveness skill: build a short script for a request or a no (Describe, Express, Assert, Reinforce, delivery plan), then optionally rehearse it in roleplay.

techniques.name: Behavioral Activation
techniques.description: Plan one small, scheduled activity chosen by what matters, with a rest check first, a prediction of enjoyment and accomplishment, and a follow-up at the next session.

techniques.name: Chain Analysis
techniques.description: Reconstruct one regretted behaviour link by link — prompting event, vulnerabilities, links, consequences — and find where the chain could break. Not run on self-harm or suicidal behaviour.

techniques.name: Wise Mind
techniques.description: Mindfulness skill for a decision pulled two ways: hear emotion mind and reasonable mind separately, pause, then ask what is known when both are taken seriously.

levels.2: moderate — two attempts from different angles
